title: A meeting was held at BSU on April 28, 2025

blocks.text: On April 28, 2025, a meeting of deans and heads of departments was held at Bishkek State University named after K. Karasayev. During the event, the issues on the agenda were widely discussed and appropriate decisions were made.

As part of the assignment from Rector Mirlan Dyldaev, Dean of the Faculty of Economics and Finance Viktor Savin, as well as Dean of the Faculty of Oriental Studies and International Relations Talasbek Mashrapov proposed strategic plans for the development of their faculties for 2025-2030.
Following the meeting, proposals were made to ensure the fulfillment of set tasks and the implementation of strategic plans.
